# WanderLuxe

> WanderLuxe is a free collaborative trip planner. A group builds one shared itinerary of flights, hotels, dining and activities; everyone can see and edit it in real time, view it as a timeline, calendar or map, and export it as a PDF or a live calendar feed. An AI assistant turns pasted booking confirmations into itinerary items and finds real places with working links.

Planning is free with no limits. The only paid feature is the Print Studio, a keepsake printed edition of a finished trip.

## Product

- [How WanderLuxe works](https://wanderluxe.io/guide): Plain-language guide to planning day by day, sharing with companions, calendar sync, PDF export, the map and calendar views, and the AI connector.
- [About WanderLuxe](https://wanderluxe.io/about): Who the product is for and what it does.
- [Explore itineraries](https://wanderluxe.io/explore): Index of every public showcase itinerary.

## Itineraries

- [5 Days in Porto Cervo](https://wanderluxe.io/explore/5-days-in-porto-cervo): 5 nights · Hotel Cala di Volpe, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Costa Smeralda. A five-night Sardinian escape in Porto Cervo: Costa Smeralda yachts, Hotel Cala di Volpe, and Michelin dining curated for slow Mediterranean summers.
- [5 Days in Mykonos](https://wanderluxe.io/explore/5-days-in-mykonos): 5 nights · Cavo Tagoo Mykonos. Five nights of curated Mykonos luxury: Belvedere Hotel suites, Nammos beach club afternoons, Scorpios sunsets, and private catamaran days in the Cyclades.
- [6 Days in Tokyo](https://wanderluxe.io/explore/6-days-in-tokyo): 6 nights · Aman Tokyo. A six-night luxury Tokyo itinerary: Aman Tokyo, sushi temples in Ginza, teamLab Planets, and the quietest corners of the city after dark.
- [3 Days in Sabi Sands, 5 Days in Cape Town](https://wanderluxe.io/explore/3-days-in-sabi-sands-5-days-in-cape-town): 8 nights · Singita Ebony, Ellerman House. An eight-night South African journey: Singita Sabi Sand Big Five safari, then Cape Town wine country, Table Mountain, and the V&A Waterfront in style.
- [5 Days in Marrakech](https://wanderluxe.io/explore/5-days-in-marrakech): 5 nights · Royal Mansour Marrakech. A five-night Marrakech escape: Royal Mansour riads, Jemaa el-Fnaa souks at dusk, an Atlas Mountain day trip, and modernist desert dining at La Mamounia.
- [6 Days in St. Barths](https://wanderluxe.io/explore/6-days-in-st-barths): 6 nights · Eden Rock - St Barths. Six nights on St. Barthélemy: Eden Rock beach suites, Le Toiny dinners, Colombier hikes, and Gustavia harbor afternoons in pure West Indies luxury.

## Integrations

- [MCP server discovery](https://wanderluxe.io/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): WanderLuxe exposes a Model Context Protocol server (OAuth 2.1) so an AI client can read and edit a signed-in user's trips.
